meta.title: RFQ: the vendor tries to bid again after revoking
warnings: resolved: “Revoke Vendor A's previous RFQ quote in the vendor portal” — switch_portal / vendor_open_event open the supplier portal as the invited QA vendor in a second browser

steps.note: Start a new multi-stage project for the RFQ.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Move to the RFQ stage before configuring it.
Add the product required for the quote.
Invite the QA vendor who will submit and later attempt the quote.
Publish the RFQ so the vendor can bid.
Verify the RFQ reached a published project page.
Continue in the vendor portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the published RFQ's pricing round as the invited vendor.
Submit the vendor's initial quote of 100.
Verify the initial vendor quote was submitted.

args.need: revoke the vendor's previously submitted RFQ quote in the vendor portal, then return to the quote sheet

steps.note: The catalog has no action for revoking a vendor quote, which is required before testing the rebid refusal.

args.because: You cannot place a quote after revoking the previous quote

steps.note: Attempt a new quote after revocation and assert Procol refuses it with the RFQ-specific message.
